# Compact Delivery Loop

Bias toward visible progress: discover in parallel, draft the smallest passing artifact, verify with the named checks, land or iterate.

## Discover (one pass)

List relevant directories, read the instruction and referenced files, and locate how success is verified.

## Draft

Implement the narrowest solution that should satisfy the contract. Avoid speculative helpers and unrelated refactors.

## Verify

Run the verifier named by the task; read stdout/stderr and inspect produced files when relevant.

## Loop

If verification fails, identify root cause and fix it; re-run verification. Do not rationalize failure away.

## Conduct

Prefer dedicated reading tools over shell cat when available; use shell for execution; keep narration short between actions.
